text:
Lina: quick usability flag — compact compare rows look great but performance badges are encroaching on the pin control at narrow widths. Screenshot: https://figma.redwood/compact-badges.png
Marco: can we collapse badges to a single icon in compact and expand on hover? keeps pin visible.
Devin: +1. alternative: reserve a tiny metrics column so pin is always in its own cell (sticky or fixed). need to check cross-browser sticky table support.
Priya: accessibility: pin must expose aria-pressed and a clear focus outline at all densities. tooltip copy: change `Pin version` -> `Pin version to this comparison`. SR should announce `Version X pinned for comparison`.
Sam: analytics: I'll add events `catalog.pin_toggled` and `catalog.metrics_collapsed`. propose A/B: medium default vs compact-default with collapsed badges; measure time-to-pin and misclicks.
Lina: small CSS test I tried: `.metrics { max-width: 88px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .pin { position: sticky; right: 8px; }` — works in Chrome but file compat ticket.
ui-bot: staging preview: https://staging.redwood/compare (build 517) behind flags `compare.compact_metrics` and `compare.pin_column`. Please test keyboard & SR flows. :rocket:
Marco: next steps: Lina to update mock with compact icon + tooltip, Priya to draft A11y acceptance, Sam to wire events, Devin to open cross-browser ticket. Sync Fri. :calendar:
